researchNotes: Official Shopify site (www.parfums-de-marly.com) fetched via its products.json feed; product pages https://www.parfums-de-marly.com/products/<handle> built from feed handles. Feed gives short descriptions only: notes recorded as flat (no pyramid stated), concentration only where the text names Extrait de Parfum, no year/perfumer/accords. Skipped gift sets, samples, discovery sets, body line. Country not stated in sources.

fragrances.name: Crécy

sources.name: Vivir — Parfums de Marly Crécy review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review scores longevity 4/5 and calls the wear intimate-to-moderate (own impressions); Scento says all-day capable, skin-dependent, best for spring/summer daytime.

fragrances.name: Oajan

sources.name: Jadof — Parfums de Marly Oajan review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: long-lasting, strong projection, winter evenings; Jadof review: about 10-12 h; Parfumo reviewer notes up to 8 h and a 3 m trail.

fragrances.name: Althaïr Exclusif

sources.name: Parfums de Marly official — Althaïr Exclusif
Vivir — Parfums de Marly Althaïr Exclusif review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir rates longevity 4/5 and sillage 4/5; Scento says long-lasting with strong projection, stronger than the original Althaïr.

fragrances.name: Pegasus Exclusif

sources.name: Parfums de Marly official — Pegasus Exclusif

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: Parfumo users average about 8.3 longevity and 7.9 sillage; estimates 6-10 hours, some 10-14; sillage moderate to strong early, then settles closer to skin. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Herod

sources.name: Scent Chronicles — Herod review (search result summary)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: many wearers 8-12 hours; Scent Chronicles 10-11 hours on most skin; projection moderate, close to skin after 2-3 hours. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season. Longevity 4, sillage 3.

fragrances.name: Palatine

sources.name: Venba Fragrance — Parfums de Marly Palatine EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailer listings: about 7-9 h with moderate sillage, some find it less tenacious; Scento user data also moderate; suited to spring daytime.

fragrances.name: Athénaïs

sources.name: Venba Fragrance — Parfums de Marly Athenais EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Reviews and retailers: roughly 5-7 h (one says 6-8 h), moderate sillage that settles close to the skin after the first hours.

fragrances.name: Oriana

sources.name: Fragplace — Oriana by Parfums de Marly

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace: typically 6-10 h, sillage rated 4/5; Escentual: airy but impressive longevity; a retailer lists moderate sillage.

fragrances.name: Valero

sources.name: Venba Fragrance — Parfums de Marly Valero Extrait
Vivir — Parfums de Marly Valero review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba and Maxaroma: about 7-9 h, moderate sillage; Vivir rates longevity and sillage 3/5, moderate for an extrait.

fragrances.name: Eragon

sources.name: Venba Fragrance — Parfums de Marly Eragon Extrait

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba/Maxaroma: 8-10 h, moderate skin-hugging sillage; Scento: long-lasting, fall and evening; Vivir finds only 4-6 h and modest projection.

fragrances.name: Carios
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Official page: 'a strong projection' and 'an extremely powerful trail'. No longevity stated. Sillage 4 only.

fragrances.name: Castley

sources.name: Perfumes.la — Castley by Parfums de Marly

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: long-lasting, moderate projection, spring daytime; Perfumes.la: moderate longevity and sillage; Parfumo reviewer about 6 h.

fragrances.name: Valaya Exclusif

sources.name: Parfums de Marly official — Valaya Exclusif

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: long-lasting, strong projection, spring evenings; Fragplace: powerful sillage; a Parfumo reviewer still smelled it after 8+ h.

fragrances.name: Haltane
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: long-lasting with strong trail, cooler months and night; The Scent Base: 8+ h with good projection.

fragrances.name: Valaya

sources.name: Vivir — Parfums de Marly Valaya review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: long-lasting, moderate projection, spring daytime; Fragplace: 6-10 h, moderate noticeable sillage; Vivir longevity 4.2/5, sillage 3.8/5.

fragrances.name: Althaïr

sources.name: Scent Chronicles — Althaïr review (search result summary)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: mostly 8-10 hours on skin (range 8-12), better in cold weather, shorter in heat; moderate-to-strong projection early then a closer skin scent. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Layton Exclusif

sources.name: Parfums de Marly official — Layton Exclusif
Vivir — Layton Exclusif review (search result summary)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most estimates 8-10 hours on skin (range 8-12); strong projection in the first hours, then close to the body; a few reviewers wanted more projection. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Galloway
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow: 6-8 h, moderate sillage and projection, listed under spring and summer fragrances; no time of day stated.

fragrances.name: Percival
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow: moderate-to-long wear, moderate-to-strong trail; Venba: mixed, most get about 4-6 h, moderate sillage, spring/summer daytime (its badges also list fall/winter). Search results cite 6-9 h elsewhere; most common view used.

fragrances.name: Kalan

sources.name: Scento — Kalan by Parfums de Marly

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base: above-average 6+ h; Scento: moderate sillage; Parfumo reviewers find it strong and lasting into the next morning.

fragrances.name: Carlisle
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba: 7-9 h, moderate-to-strong sillage, fall/winter evenings; Beautinow: 8-10 h, moderate-to-strong sillage, no season stated. Sources broadly agree.

fragrances.name: Layton
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries of reviews: 'around 8 to 10 hours' (Fragrantica), some 6-12; sillage 'strong early, then a closer moderate trail' (Profumobase). Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity or season.

fragrances.name: Sedley

sources.name: The Last Spritz — Sedley (search result summary)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most sources say 5-8 hours on most skin (Fragranote 5-8, The Last Spritz 5-7); sillage mostly moderate, close to skin later, one reviewer calls it soft. Longevity 3, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Greenley
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: about 6-8 hours on skin most often (Fragranzo 6-8, Fragman 5-7, Vivir 8-10+); sillage described as moderate, strongest in first few hours. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Athalia

sources.name: Venba Fragrance — Parfums de Marly Athalia EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailer listings: about 6-9 h with moderate sillage and soft-to-moderate projection; review site gives longevity 8.7/10, sillage 6.8/10.

fragrances.name: Godolphin

sources.name: The Scent Base — Godolphin (search result summary)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most sources 8-10 hours on skin (perfume.com 8-12, Scent's Angel 8-10, Scent Base 6-10); sillage moderate to strong early, then softer. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Pegasus
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries of reviews: mostly 8-10 hours on skin (range 6-12); sillage strong at first, moderate-to-strong for 2-3 hours then close to skin. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season. Longevity 4, sillage 3.

fragrances.name: Delina La Rosée

sources.name: Parfums de Marly official — Delina La Rosée
Venba Fragrance — Delina La Rosée EDP (search result summary)
Vivir — Delina La Rosée review (search result summary)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most estimates 6-9 hours on skin (Vivir 6-8, Venba 7-9; some reviewers 5-6 or 3-5); sillage moderate and close to the skin. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page's 'morning caress' is imagery, not a wear time, so no usage recorded.

fragrances.name: Safanad
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most accounts about 6.5-9 hours on skin (measured 6.5-7.25 by one blogger, Vivir 8-10); Vivir rates sillage 3.5/5, 'not a strong projector'. Longevity 4, sillage 3. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Meliora

sources.name: The Sniff Test — Parfums de Marly Meliora

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailers and reviewers: roughly 6-8 h (one says 7-10 h), moderate noticeable-but-unobtrusive sillage.

fragrances.name: Delina Exclusif

sources.name: Parfums de Marly official — Delina Exclusif

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: estimates 8-12+ hours on skin (one 8-10, others 10-14); moderate to strong sillage, strong for the first 4-5 hours; one reviewer disagreed. Longevity 4, sillage 4. Official page states no longevity, sillage or season.

fragrances.name: Cassili
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Jadof: 7-9 h; ScentsAngel: 8-10 h, moderate intimate projection; one retailer says 4-6 h; John Lewis rates both moderate.

fragrances.name: Delina
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Official page calls it 'the daytime icon' (read as daytime wear). Search summaries: 6-12 hours on skin, most often 8-10; strong early projection; Parfumo community averages about 8.4 longevity, 8.1 sillage. Longevity 4, sillage 4.
